newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says too weak, too strong yen undesirable - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: MOF says too weak, too strong yen undesirable - Jiji.

text.p: An excessively weak or strong yen is undesirable, Eisuke Sakakibara, head of the Japanese Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, was quoted as saying by Jiji news agency on Wednesday.

Jiji said he made the comments to reporters in response to a question on the dollar's fall below 111 yen in late morning trade. Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka also later said that an excessively weak or strong yen was undesirable and that MOF would deal with foreign exchange movements in an appropriate manner, Jiji reported.
